problem: Historical exact-version viewer coverage was concentrated in Dataset and Structure examples; other registered scientific object families lacked a deterministic archive/version regression.

scope.exclusion_reason: These descriptors are not registered ScientificObject types in the current object authority and therefore require a separate result-level/object-type registration decision.

behavior: create v1 and v2 on the same logical ScientificObject
open the exact v1 Viewer projection while archived
assert v1 remains non-current and payload-ready
assert restore keeps v2 current and version count unchanged

benefit: Historical viewer fidelity is now protected across every currently registered ScientificObject-backed viewer family without silently promoting descriptor-only result viewers to ScientificObject authority.
